execution.description: Started the affected Cooling and Graphite suites through the repository canonical wrapper in Ubuntu using explicit linked-worktree Git paths.

expected: The canonical wrapper should copy the checkout into its pinned Linux container and run the requested suites.
observed: The wrapper built the pinned image but stopped before pytest because the Windows-created ignored .pytest_cache denied Linux xattr and copy access.
keep: Keep the explicit linked-worktree Git binding; it passed the wrapper's repository checks.
change: Remove only the ignored generated .pytest_cache from the verified worktree path and retry the same canonical command.
